en: The postcard depicts a black-and-white photograph of a three-story building with classical architectural elements, partially framed by tall trees on both sides. The approach to the building is via a flight of stairs, and there are tables and chairs set outside, suggesting it may be a guest house or hotel. The reverse side includes typical postcard formatting, as well as the printed text identifying 'HOTEL BOLIVAR-HAUS' in Bad Pyrmont and museum information (Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont) as well as other address details.
